title: RAG Quality Engine: An Evaluation-First Platform for Retrieval-Augmented Generation Quality
description: RAG Quality Engine is an open-source software project for building, testing, and observing retrieval-augmented generation systems. It provides deterministic offline workflows for document ingestion, lexical/vector/hybrid retrieval, grounded answer generation, citation validation, evaluation metrics, trace persistence, a FastAPI service, a command-line interface, and notebook-based analysis.
